description: Self-contained source-def registry for board-worker runtimes.

bindTo.description: Namespace key — fetched result is written to fetched_sources.<bindTo>.

outputFile.description: Board-relative output path written by the source executor.

projections.description: Named projections resolved from card_data/requires before source execution.

skip_when.description: Optional JSONata predicate over requires.* and card_data.* only. When it evaluates truthy this source_def is skipped — treated as if absent: not queued, no fetch, no fetched_sources entry. The card completes once remaining (non-skipped) source_defs and computes finish.

optionalForCompletionGating.description: When true this source does not block default completion gating.

script.description: Legacy direct-run command when no task executor is registered.

extraSchema.description: Board topology context passed via --extra (base64-encoded JSON, baked at init).

aiWorkspaceRoot.description: Absolute path to the AI assistant workspace root (used as spawn cwd for copilot/foundry/mcp handlers).

serverUrl.description: Base URL of the hosting server (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7799). Used by source kinds that call server-side endpoints.

agentFaceMcp.description: Agentface MCP path used for liveboards.* tools (for example /agent/mcp). Combined with serverUrl by source kinds that call the same liveboards MCP surface agents use.

boardLiveCardsCliJs.description: Absolute path to board-live-cards-cli.js when configured by the runtime.

stepMachineCliPath.description: Absolute path to step-machine-cli.js when configured by the runtime.

foundryEndpoint.description: Azure AI Foundry project endpoint (used by foundry-handler when source_def does not set its own).

foundryTaskExecutorAgentId.description: Foundry agent id used by source-def foundry-handler when source_def does not set its own.

validate.message: urls.url is required and must be a string.

manifest.description: URL fetch via interpolation and cache, with optional fan-out over a projected URL list.

semanticManifest.purpose: Fetch deterministic HTTP resources and return their response payloads as source data.
bestFor: REST or HTTP JSON endpoints
lightweight polling of public or internal APIs
fan-out fetches driven by projected identifiers
expects: optional headers, method, args, or cache configuration
optional projections for interpolation or fan-out
semanticManifest.returns: Fetched HTTP response content, optionally across multiple projected requests.

validate.message: copilot must be an object, or prompt_template must be a top-level string.

semanticManifest.purpose: Run a Copilot-backed generative source to synthesize or transform data from prompt inputs.
bestFor: language-driven summarization or extraction
small structured generations from runtime inputs
reasoning tasks that deterministic sources cannot provide
expects: a prompt_template or copilot config object
a result shape when consumers need structured output
semanticManifest.returns: Model-generated text or structured content derived from the authored prompt and runtime context.

validate.message: mcp.tool is required and must be a string.

manifest.description: Invoke an MCP tool via a named server registry entry or an inline connection config.

semanticManifest.purpose: Call a tool exposed by an MCP server and use the tool result as source data.
bestFor: tool-backed reads or mutations exposed through MCP
server-integrated domain workflows
capability surfaces that are already modeled as MCP tools
expects: a logical server name or inline server connection config
an optional input object for the tool's arguments
an optional responseShape adapter for known result formats (e.g. kusto-v2)
semanticManifest.returns: The invoked MCP tool result, validated against the selected server/tool surface and optionally adapted by responseShape.

server.description: String: logical server name from mcp-server/registry.json. Object: inline connection config (transport, url/command, etc.).

input.description: Arguments object forwarded verbatim to the upstream MCP tool. String values support {{projection}} interpolation.

responseShape.description: Optional adapter applied to the upstream result. Supported values: "kusto-v2" — extracts the PrimaryResult frame from a Kusto v2 frames array and emits { columns: [{name,type}], rows: [{<col>: <value>, ...}] }.

validate.message: mock must be a string key.

manifest.description: Look up values from demo MOCK_DB map.

semanticManifest.purpose: Return deterministic canned data for local testing, demos, and offline card development.
bestFor: offline prototyping
stable regression fixtures
source contract testing without external dependencies
expects: a mock key present in the configured mock database
semanticManifest.returns: Static fixture data associated with the selected mock key.

validate.message: foundry.prompt_template is required and must be a string.

manifest.description: Azure AI Foundry Agent invocation via Managed Identity.

semanticManifest.purpose: Invoke an Azure AI Foundry agent source for managed generative or agentic workflows.
bestFor: Azure-hosted agent tasks
managed identity based AI integrations
structured agent responses with enterprise configuration
expects: optional args and expected result shape
semanticManifest.returns: Agent-produced content or structured output from the configured Foundry surface.

validate.message: sqlite.db is required and must be a string.
sqlite.query is required and must be a string.

manifest.description: Query a SQLite database via the sqlite handler's local query runner.

semanticManifest.purpose: Execute local SQLite queries and return row or execution results as source data.
bestFor: deterministic local reads
ad hoc analytical queries over board-local databases
parameterized data retrieval without external services
expects: a database identifier or path alias
optional positional params and query mode
semanticManifest.returns: SQLite query results or execution output from the local database runner.

manifest.description: Observe the hosting board's own runtime status through the liveboards agentface MCP surface and return a deterministic observation reading.

semanticManifest.purpose: Read the hosting board's live runtime status (per-card states, requires/provides wiring, completion counts) through the same liveboards agentface MCP surface agents use, and reduce it into a compact deterministic observation that downstream jsonata compute can band, flag, and publish as tokens.
bestFor: board-level health, coverage, and progress signals
feeding a strategist or dashboard a quantized value/health reading
observations that must be computed server-side from board state not available as tokens
expects: an observables config object selecting which observation to compute
semanticManifest.returns: A deterministic observation object: per-status counts, blocked/failed/in-progress tallies and id lists, requires/provides coverage totals, and a settled flag.

scope.description: Which observation to compute. Default "board-runtime" reads inspect.board-runtime-status for the hosting board.

excludeCardIds.description: Card ids (array) or a projection key (string resolving to an array) to exclude from the observation, e.g. the observatory's own card and the strategist, so the reading reflects only the work graph.

timeout.description: Read timeout in milliseconds for the board status call.
